blocks.text: Complete the sentences. Select the correct opposite:
Samantha is very lazy. She’s always resting on the bed. She doesn’t like to practice any sport or helping her mother with the housework. It *would be* better if she didn’t rest so much.

Nathalie is watching T.V. now. She likes to watch T.V. a lot. She has *Cable T.V.* She turns on the television in the morning and she continues watching it until the afternoon. It *would be* better if she didn’t watch T.V. so much.

items.q: Is she always resting on the bed?
Do you think it would be better if she didn’t rest so much?
Does she like to watch T.V.?
When does she turn on the T.V.?
Does she continue watching it during the afternoon?
Do you think it would be better if she didn’t watch T.V. so much?
Does Nathalie have a Cable T.V.?

rows: I wish you wouldn’t speak so fast.
*When* somebody is making too much noise…?
I wish you wouldn’t make so much noise.
*When* somebody is making too many mistakes…?
I wish you wouldn’t make so many mistakes.
